description: GPUDrive is a data-driven multi-agent driving simulator published by the EMERGE research team. Its C++ implementation uses the Madrona engine, with Python bindings and Gymnasium interfaces for Torch and JAX. Users load road scenarios, configure observations and actors, and run or train driving policies; outputs include simulated trajectories and agent-evaluation results. Coverage follows the supplied scenarios, including converted Waymo Open Motion data, with no claim of a representative global road sample. Public software source is free under MIT, while external datasets and pretrained policies have separate access and terms. A limitation is the documented CUDA range of 12.2–12.4 for this release, and changing observation settings can affect pretrained-policy performance. The advertised simulation speed is a provider result that was not reproduced here. GPUDrive can support road-behaviour and control simulations, complementary to SUMO (model-sumo). The repository provides tutorials, data-conversion instructions and the ICLR 2025 citation. No scenario files, policy weights or GPU dependencies were downloaded.
